ideas.title: +1 Arm Per Punch
ideas.hook: You start as a scrap robot with one arm. Every punch you land bolts on +1 more arm, so a hundred punches later you are a spinning wall of fists sending scrap cubes flying across the yard.
core_loop: Punch scrap cubes on the practice pad
Each punch adds +1 arm, and more arms hit more times per swing
Launched cubes land in distance zones that pay out bolts
Spend bolts on arm types (drill, magnet, rocket) and rebirth to a bigger chassis
ideas.twist: Arms add weight: past a point you tip over unless you buy a wider base, so balance upgrades matter as much as raw arms.
retention: Rebirth into bigger chassis with arm caps reset
Offline bolt earnings from your arm count
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action is at 2.27 momentum and up 0.54 this week ([🎃] +1 Venom Evolution 17.9K CCU, [🎃] +1 Stone Skipping 11.8K), the "+1 ___" title formula is at 2.51 (+0.66), and Robots / mechs is the fastest-climbing theme at 2.28 (+1.06 this week) behind Steel Fighters (14.8K). +1 stat on Robots is the second-biggest open gap (score 6.35).
ideas.differentiator: Other +1 games grow a number; here the stat is visible on your body, so the screenshot of a 200-arm robot sells the game.

ideas.title: Race Robots for Parts
ideas.hook: Build a robot runner in your garage from legs, wheels and jets, then race it against other players' robots on obstacle tracks. Winners take a random part off the losers' scrap pile.
core_loop: Snap parts onto your robot frame in the garage
Enter a 6-robot race on a rotating obstacle track
Finish position pays parts and cash
Fill the part index and tune your build for each track type
ideas.twist: Robots run on their own: you only pick the route at forks and fire one boost, so the build you made in the garage decides most of the race.
monetization: VIP garage with 2 extra build slots (~300 R$)
retention: Part index with rare legendary parts
Season ladder with a robot trophy
Garage that shows off your best builds
ideas.why_now: Robots / mechs jumped 1.06 this week to 2.28 momentum (Steel Fighters 14.8K CCU, RoChess! 9.7K, [🎃] Create a Robot Fighter 5.0K), and Race / drive holds 1.12 (+0.10) with Backseat Rally (19.6K). The Racing subgenre is at 1.53 led by Flying Tesla Roadster (4.3K).
ideas.differentiator: Robot games are fighters; this one turns the build into a racer, so wins come from smart parts, not fast fingers.

ideas.title: Sketch Ships for Stars
ideas.hook: Draw any shape you like, and it becomes your spaceship. Physics decides how it flies: a long thin line pierces the clouds, a blob tumbles back down. Fly higher to earn stars.
core_loop: Sketch a ship outline on the launch pad
Pick where the boosters go and launch
Stars and coins pay out by height reached
Unlock new materials (wood, metal, crystal) and longer ink
ideas.twist: Each planet layer has different gravity and wind, so the shape that wins the sky fails in the asteroid belt and you keep redrawing.
retention: Gallery of the best ships each week
ideas.why_now: Paint / create sits at 2.20 momentum (+0.07) with [🎃] Kukirin Life [Testing] (21.9K CCU) and A Long Flight [SANDBOX] (9.0K). The Physics Sim subgenre is up 0.83 this week to 2.17 (Ragdoll Reality 30.9K, Crazy Diver 8.8K), and Space rose 0.40 to 1.42 with roll the world 🌎 (5.7K).
ideas.differentiator: Drawing games score your art; here your drawing is the vehicle and physics grades it, so every player invents a different ship.

ideas.title: Grow Sidekicks for Heroes
ideas.hook: Plant hero seeds in your rooftop garden and they sprout into tiny sidekicks with random powers. Water them, then send them out on city rescue calls to earn cash.
core_loop: Plant seeds in rooftop plots
Sidekicks sprout with a random power and rarity
Send them on rescue calls that pay cash over time
Buy rarer seeds and more plots, fill the sidekick index
ideas.twist: Sidekicks planted next to each other cross-pollinate, so placing a fire sprout beside an ice sprout can grow a rare steam hero.
retention: Sidekick index with secret cross-pollination combos
Weekly villain event that needs certain powers
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm is a solid trend at 1.10 momentum with 18 new games spread out (Durian Garden 🍈 14.1K CCU at 7 days old, Harvest It All 🎃 3.9K). Superheroes / powers rose 0.15 to 1.39 (Superhero Arena 9.0K), and Grow + Superheroes is an open gap (score 2.13).
ideas.differentiator: Hero games make you the hero; here you farm a whole team of tiny heroes and breed new powers by where you plant them.

ideas.title: Grow Wands for Wizards
ideas.hook: Wand trees grow in your enchanted orchard. Snap off the branches, carve them into wands at your stall, and sell them to wizards who test each one with a spell right at the counter.
core_loop: Plant and water wand trees
Harvest branches when they glow
Carve wands at the stall (longer carving = better wand)
Sell to wizard customers for gold and buy rarer trees
ideas.twist: Wizards test the wand on the spot: a bad one backfires and turns your stall into a frog pond for a minute, a great one gets you a tip and a review.
retention: Daily rare wizard customer with a big order
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop holds 1.95 momentum on 23 new games (🎃 Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 35.6K CCU, 🧸 My Small Business 18.2K), Grow / farm sits at 1.10 (Durian Garden 🍈 14.1K), and Fantasy / medieval is up 0.17 to 1.40 with 🍀 Tower Of Luck [1.8] (4.8K).
ideas.differentiator: Shop games sell food; here you grow the stock yourself and customers react with live spells, so each sale is a small show.

ideas.title: Bump Cars for Crowns
ideas.hook: A car party game: every round is a new car minigame (sumo on a shrinking island, car soccer, ramp limbo, hot-potato bomb car). Win rounds for crowns, spend crowns on goofier cars.
core_loop: Join a lobby and pick your car
Play 5 short car minigames in a row
Earn crowns for placing in each round
Unlock cars with different weight and speed
ideas.twist: Heavy cars win sumo but lose races, so you swap cars between rounds based on what minigame comes up next.
ideas.why_now: Vehicles climbed 0.44 this week to 1.73 momentum ([🎃] Bike For Egg! 27.9K CCU, [🎃] Bike Universe 27.1K), Vehicle Sim sits at 1.62 (+0.18) and Realistic Car Destruction (6.4K, 13 days old) shows crash play pulling players. Party / minigames is up 0.30 to 1.17 with [NEW] Cidro Janji (Jawa Party) (3.3K).
ideas.differentiator: Car games are about owning cars or racing; this mixes short silly car rounds so even new players win something each match.

ideas.title: Lay Tracks for Cash
ideas.hook: Lay train track across a low-poly valley from your station to towns that want service. Every train you run pays per passenger, and the longer your line, the more towns pay.
core_loop: Place track pieces from your station toward a town
Buy a train and run it along your line
Passengers pay cash at each stop
Unlock bridges, tunnels and faster trains to reach far towns
ideas.twist: You can ride your own train first-person and take the controls, and a perfect stop at the platform earns a bonus fare.
monetization: VIP steam and bullet train skins
retention: New towns and biomes to connect
ideas.why_now: Tycoon / base building has 63 new games spread out at 1.40 momentum ([🎃]Climb For Animals Eggs🥚 33.0K CCU, 🧸 My Small Business 18.2K), Vehicles rose 0.44 to 1.73, and the low-poly art style is rising fastest at 3.0 momentum (Ragdoll Reality 30.9K).
ideas.differentiator: Train sims are about driving one route; here you build the network yourself, and every new line visibly grows your map.

ideas.title: Busk for Tips
ideas.hook: Start on a street corner with a bucket drum. Every beat you hit draws +1 listener, listeners drop tips, and tips buy bigger instruments and a better corner.
core_loop: Tap to the beat on your instrument
Each hit on time adds +1 to your crowd
Crowd drops tips into your case
Upgrade instruments and move to busier streets
ideas.twist: Another player can set up across the street and steal your crowd in a 30-second play-off; the bigger crowd keeps both.
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action is at 2.27 (+0.54 this week) and the "+1 ___" formula is at 2.51 (+0.66). Music / dance is a medium trend at 1.15 led by [🎃] +1 Dance Battle Evolution (6.0K CCU) but slipped 0.27 this week, so this leans on the +1 loop rather than the theme.
ideas.differentiator: Music games are rhythm tests; here the street crowd is the visible stat, so your progress shows as a growing audience around you.

ideas.title: +1 Coin Per Bounce
ideas.hook: Jump off the top of a skyscraper as a ragdoll and bounce off awnings, cars and trampolines on the way down. Every bounce pays +1 coin, and bounciness upgrades turn one jump into hundreds of bounces.
core_loop: Jump from the roof as a ragdoll
Each bounce pays +1 coin (multipliers on gold trampolines)
Spend coins on bounciness, coin multipliers and taller buildings
Rebirth into a richer city with bigger payouts
ideas.twist: You can steer your ragdoll a little mid-air, so aiming for the gold awnings gives skill players a reason to keep playing.
ideas.why_now: Money / rich rose 0.36 this week to 2.15 momentum on 44 new games ([🎃] Steal A Pet And Ride It! 25.1K CCU), +1 stat per action is at 2.27 (+0.54), and Physics Sim jumped 0.83 to 2.17 with Ragdoll Reality 🩸 (30.9K, 15 days old) and Realistic Ragdoll Engine 🩸 (16.1K).
ideas.differentiator: Ragdoll games are pure sandbox; this adds a simple +1 money loop on top so every fall has a goal.

ideas.title: Grow Moon Melons for Cash
ideas.hook: Run a farm on the moon. Low gravity means ripe melons float off the vine, so you jump after them before they drift into space, then sell them to the space station.
core_loop: Plant moon seeds in your crater plot
Melons ripen and float up
Jump in low gravity to catch them
Sell at the station and buy domes, rarer seeds and jetpacks
ideas.twist: Meteor showers crack your dome now and then; fix it fast or your floating crop escapes to another player's farm.
monetization: Luck pass for rare cosmic melons
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm holds 1.10 with 18 new games spread out (Durian Garden 🍈 14.1K CCU at 7 days old, [🌱] Grow a Plant 2.6K), Sell / run a shop is at 1.95 (🎃 Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 35.6K), and Space rose 0.40 this week to 1.42 (+1 Slinky Escape 4.5K).
ideas.differentiator: Farm games are ground-bound; low gravity turns every harvest into a short jump-and-catch moment.
